source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 10 (PDF 229-250), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 10 (Electromagnetism) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 In 1820, the scientist who found that electricity and magnetism are correlated was:
(1820 mein kis scientist ne maloom kiya ke electricity aur magnetism aapas mein jure hue (correlated) hain?)
blocks.explanation: 1820 mein Hans Christian Oersted ne maloom kiya ke electricity aur magnetism jure hue hain (introduction).

book_ref.quote: Hans Christian Orsted found that electricity and magnetism are correlated

blocks.prompt:
2 Electromagnetism is the area of physics that studies how:
(Electromagnetism physics ka woh hissa hai jo kya parhta hai?)

options.text: electric charges aur magnetic fields aapas mein kaise asar karte hain
heat solids mein kaise behti hai
roshni aainon se kaise lautti hai
masses aik doosre ko kaise kheenchte hain

blocks.explanation: Electromagnetism parhta hai ke electric charges aur magnetic fields aapas mein kaise asar karte hain (introduction).

book_ref.quote: studies how electric charges and magnetic fields interact

blocks.prompt:
3 Lodestone, the natural mineral with which magnetism started, is:
(Lodestone, woh qudrati mineral jis se magnetism ki shuruat hui, kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lodestone yani magnetite (Fe₃O₄) iron aur steel ko kheenchta hai aur Earth ke poles ki seedh mein aata hai; is se compass bana (introduction box).

book_ref.quote: Lodestone, or magnetite (Fe₃O₄), can attract metals like iron and steel

blocks.prompt:
4 A current is produced in a conductor placed in a magnetic field when the magnetic field is:
(Magnetic field mein rakhe conductor mein current kab paida hota hai?)

options.text: Earth ke field ke mutawazi ho

blocks.explanation: Badalta hua (changing) magnetic field us mein rakhe conductor mein current paida karta hai (introduction).

book_ref.quote: a changing magnetic field gives rise to a current in a conductor placed in it

blocks.text: 10.1 Force on a current-carrying conductor in a uniform magnetic field

blocks.prompt:
5 A current-carrying conductor placed in a magnetic field:
(Magnetic field mein rakhe current wale conductor par kya hota hai?)

options.text: us par koi force nahi lagti
us ka current khatam ho jata hai
woh permanent magnet ban jata hai

blocks.explanation: Tajrube se dekha gaya hai ke magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force lagti hai (10.1).

book_ref.quote: a current-carrying conductor placed in a magnetic field experiences a force

blocks.prompt:
6 The force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field is due to the interaction between:
(Magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force kin do cheezon ke aapas ke asar se hoti hai?)

options.text: us ka charge aur Earth ki gravity
us ka apna magnetic field aur bahar ka magnetic field

blocks.explanation: Conductor ka apna magnetic field bahar ke field se asar karta hai, jaise do magnets aik doosre par (10.1).

book_ref.quote: due to the interaction between its own magnetic field and the external magnetic field

blocks.prompt:
7 A current-carrying conductor in a uniform magnetic field moves towards the side where the resultant field is:
(Uniform magnetic field mein current wala conductor us taraf harkat karta hai jahan resultant field:)
blocks.explanation: Dono fields aik taraf mil kar taaqatwar aur doosri taraf aik doosre ko kaat dete hain; conductor kamzor field ki taraf jata hai (10.1).

book_ref.quote: the conductor moves towards the side where the field is weaker

blocks.prompt:
8 The force on a current-carrying conductor placed perpendicular to a magnetic field is:
(Magnetic field par amoodi rakhe current wale conductor par force ki simt kya hoti hai?)

options.text: conductor aur field dono par amoodi

blocks.explanation: Force F conductor aur magnetic field dono par amoodi (perpendicular) hoti hai (10.1).

book_ref.quote: Thus, the force F is perpendicular to both the conductor and the magnetic field.

blocks.prompt:
9 In Fleming's left-hand rule, the first finger points in the direction of the:
(Fleming ke left-hand rule mein pehli ungli (first finger) kis ki simt batati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehli ungli: magnetic field; doosri ungli: current; angootha: force (10.1).

book_ref.quote: the first finger points in the direction of magnetic field

blocks.prompt:
10 In Fleming's left-hand rule, the thumb points in the direction of the:
(Fleming ke left-hand rule mein angootha kis ki simt batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehli ungli field aur doosri ungli current ki taraf ho to angootha force ki simt batata hai (10.1).

book_ref.quote: the thumb will then point in the direction of force

blocks.prompt:
11 In the right hand rule for the force on a conductor, the fingers of the right hand are curled from:
(Conductor par force ke right hand rule mein daayen haath ki ungliyan kis se kis ki taraf mori jaati hain?)

options.text: current se magnetic field ki taraf, chhote angle se
magnetic field se current ki taraf, bare angle se
magnetic field se force ki taraf

blocks.explanation: Ungliyan chhote angle se current se field ki taraf morein; seedha angootha force ki simt batata hai (10.1).

book_ref.quote: Curl fingers of your right hand from current to magnetic field through small angle

blocks.prompt:
12 The magnitude of force on a conductor placed perpendicular to a magnetic field is directly proportional to:
(Magnetic field par amoodi conductor par force ki magnitude kis ke seedhe tanasub (directly proportional) mein hai?)

options.text: I aur B, lekin L nahi

blocks.explanation: Tajrube se F ∝ BIL: force current I, lambai L aur field B teeno ke tanasub mein hai (10.1).

book_ref.quote: directly proportional to the current I in the conductor

blocks.prompt:
13 The strength of the magnetic field B is also known as:
(Magnetic field ki strength B ko aur kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Magnetic field ki strength ko magnetic induction B bhi kehte hain; is ki simt field wali hai (10.1).

book_ref.quote: The strength of the magnetic field is also known as the magnetic induction B

blocks.prompt:
14 In F = kBIL, the value of the constant k in SI units is:
(F = kBIL mein SI units mein constant k ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: SI units mein k = 1 hai, is liye F = BIL (Eq. 10.1).

book_ref.quote: In SI units, the value of k = 1. Therefore,

blocks.prompt:
15 The magnetic field strength is numerically equal to the force on a conductor of:
(Magnetic field strength adadi tor par kis conductor par lagne wali force ke barabar hai?)

options.text: 1 m lamba, 1 A current wala, field par amoodi
1 m lamba, 1 A current wala, field ke mutawazi
1 cm lamba, 1 A current wala, field par amoodi
koi bhi lambai, 1 A current, koi bhi angle

blocks.explanation: B = F/IL: B us force ke barabar hai jo field par amoodi, 1 A current wale 1 m conductor par lagti hai (10.1).

book_ref.quote: placed perpendicular to the magnetic field.

blocks.prompt:
16 A wire of length 1 m carrying 1 A at right angles to a uniform field experiences a force of 0.5 N. The field is:
(1 A current wali 1 m taar uniform field par amoodi hai aur us par 0.5 N force lagti hai. Field kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The SI unit of B is tesla (T).

blocks.prompt:
17 Magnetic induction B is a:
(Magnetic induction B kis qisam ki quantity hai?)

options.text: vector quantity, field ki simt mein

blocks.explanation: Magnetic induction vector (simti) quantity hai; is ki simt magnetic field wali hai (10.1).

book_ref.quote: It may be noted that magnetic induction is a vector quantity.

blocks.prompt:
18 In F = IL × B, the direction of the vector L is:
(F = IL × B mein vector L ki simt kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: L ki magnitude conductor ki lambai hai aur simt current ke bahao ki taraf (10.1).

book_ref.quote: its direction is along the flow of current

blocks.prompt:
19 When a conductor makes an angle θ with B, the force depends on the component of L:
(Jab conductor B se θ angle banaye to force L ke kis component par munhasir hai?)

options.text: B ke mutawazi, yani L cos θ
B ke mutawazi, yani L sin θ
B par amoodi, yani L cos θ
B par amoodi, yani L sin θ

blocks.explanation: Sirf B par amoodi component L sin θ kaam aata hai, is liye F = BIL sin θ (Eq. 10.2).

book_ref.quote: we will use the component of L perpendicular to B

blocks.prompt:
20 The force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field is maximum when the angle between the conductor and the field is:
(Magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force sab se zyada kab hoti hai jab conductor aur field ka angle ho:)
blocks.explanation: F = BIL sin θ, θ = 90° par sab se zyada (BIL) hoti hai (10.1).

book_ref.quote: the force will be maximum (BIL) when the conductor is perpendicular to the field

blocks.prompt:
21 A current-carrying wire is laid along the direction of a uniform magnetic field. The force on it is:
(Current wali taar uniform magnetic field ki seedh mein rakhi hai. Us par force kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: θ = 0 par sin θ = 0, is liye F = 0 (10.1).

book_ref.quote: it will be zero when the conductor is along the field

blocks.prompt:
22 A 30 cm wire carrying 4 A is placed perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field of 0.5 T. The force on it is:
(4 A current wali 30 cm taar 0.5 T ke uniform magnetic field par amoodi rakhi hai. Us par force kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: carrying a current I and placed perpendicular to a magnetic field of strength B, is given by

blocks.prompt:
23 A 50 cm wire carrying 6 A makes an angle of 30° with a uniform magnetic field of 0.4 T. The force on the wire is:
(6 A current wali 50 cm taar 0.4 T ke uniform magnetic field se 30° ka angle banati hai. Taar par force kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Substituting the values in Eq. (10.2):

blocks.prompt:
24 A 40 cm wire carrying 3 A at right angles to a magnetic field experiences a force of 0.24 N. The field strength is:
(Magnetic field par amoodi, 3 A current wali 40 cm taar par 0.24 N force lagti hai. Field ki strength kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Equation B = F/IL also gives us the unit of B.

blocks.prompt:
25 If the current in a conductor placed perpendicular to a magnetic field is doubled and its length is halved, the force on it:
(Magnetic field par amoodi conductor ka current double aur lambai aadhi kar di jaye to us par force:)
blocks.explanation: F = BIL; I double aur L aadha karne se IL aur F wahi rehte hain (10.1).

book_ref.quote: From Eq. (10.1) we can see that B = F/IL

blocks.prompt:
26 The vector form of the force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field is:
(Magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force ki vector shakal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vector shakal mein F = I L × B (Eq. 10.3).

book_ref.quote: In the vector form the Eq. 10.2 can be written as

blocks.prompt:
27 According to the chapter, the Earth's magnetic field is approximately that of a dipole whose south magnetic pole is towards:
(Chapter ke mutabiq Earth ka magnetic field taqreeban aik dipole jaisa hai jis ka south magnetic pole kis taraf hai?)
blocks.explanation: Farzi bar magnet ka south magnetic pole geographic north pole ki taraf hai (10.1 box).

book_ref.quote: Where the south magnetic pole is towards the geographic north pole

blocks.prompt:
28 The number of magnetic lines passing through a patch of area A is called:
(Kisi area A se guzarne wali magnetic lines ki tadaad ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Area A se guzarne wali magnetic lines ki tadaad magnetic flux hai (10.2).

book_ref.quote: The magnetic flux through a patch of area A is the number of magnetic lines passing through this area.

blocks.prompt:
29 The magnetic flux through a plane area A in a uniform field B is given by:
(Uniform field B mein plane area A se magnetic flux kis se milta hai?)

options.text: B aur A ka cross product
B aur A ka dot product

blocks.explanation: ϕ_B = B · A = BA cos θ (Eq. 10.5, 10.6).

book_ref.quote: is given by dot product of B and A.

blocks.prompt:
30 Magnetic flux is a scalar quantity because it is:
(Magnetic flux scalar quantity kyun hai?)

options.text: do vectors ka cross product hai
do vectors ka dot product hai

blocks.explanation: ϕ_B = B · A; do vectors ka dot product scalar hota hai (10.2).

book_ref.quote: shows that ϕ_B is a scaler quantity

blocks.prompt:
31 The direction of the vector area A of a plane element is:
(Plane element ke vector area A ki simt kya hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: A aisa vector hai jis ki magnitude area hai aur simt surface ke normal (amood) ki taraf (10.2).

book_ref.quote: whose direction is along the normal to the surface of the element

blocks.prompt:
32 The magnetic flux through an area is maximum when the magnetic field is:
(Kisi area se magnetic flux sab se zyada kab hota hai jab magnetic field:)

options.text: area ke plane ke mutawazi ho
area ke normal ki seedh mein ho

blocks.explanation: Normal ki seedh mein θ = 0, cos 0° = 1, is liye flux sab se zyada, BA (10.2).

book_ref.quote: In Fig. 10.7(a), the field is directed along the normal to the area

blocks.prompt:
33 A loop is placed so that the magnetic field is parallel to its plane. The magnetic flux through it is:
(Loop aise rakha hai ke magnetic field us ke plane ke mutawazi hai. Us se magnetic flux kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: B aur normal ka angle 90° hai; cos 90° = 0, is liye flux sifar (10.2).

book_ref.quote: When the field is parallel to the plane of the area

blocks.prompt:
34 To find the flux through a curved surface in a uniform field, the surface is:
(Uniform field mein curved surface se flux nikalne ke liye surface ko kya kiya jata hai?)

options.text: aik seedha area maana jata hai
chhote plane elements mein baant kar un ka flux jama kiya jata hai
us ke kinare ki lambai li jati hai
chhor diya jata hai, flux sifar hai

blocks.explanation: Har chhota element plane maana jata hai aur sab elements ka BA cos θ jama kiya jata hai (10.2).

book_ref.quote: the curved surface is divided into a number of small surface elements

blocks.prompt:
35 The SI unit of magnetic flux is the weber, which is equal to:
(Magnetic flux ki SI unit weber hai; yeh kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tesla ki definition se flux ki unit N m A⁻¹ hai, jise weber kehte hain (10.2).

book_ref.quote: the unit of magnetic flux is N m A⁻¹ which is called weber (Wb)

blocks.prompt:
36 Magnetic induction B is also called magnetic flux density because it is:
(Magnetic induction B ko magnetic flux density kyun kehte hain?)

options.text: B par amoodi fi unit area flux hai
coil ke fi turn flux hai

blocks.explanation: B, B par amoodi surface ke fi unit area flux hai, is liye isay flux density kehte hain, unit Wb m⁻² (10.2).

book_ref.quote: hence, it is also called as magnetic flux density

blocks.prompt:
37 Which one is NOT a unit of magnetic flux density?
(In mein se kaun si magnetic flux density ki unit NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Flux density Wb m⁻² ya N A⁻¹ m⁻¹ (tesla) mein napi jati hai; akela Wb flux ki unit hai (10.2).

book_ref.quote: measured in terms of Wb m⁻² or N A⁻¹ m⁻¹ (tesla)

blocks.prompt:
38 A field of 0.5 T passes normally through a square loop of side 20 cm. The magnetic flux through the loop is:
(0.5 T ka field 20 cm side wale square loop se amoodan guzarta hai. Loop se magnetic flux kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: If B represents the number of lines passing through unit area

blocks.prompt:
39 A uniform field of 0.8 T makes an angle of 60° with the normal to a loop of area 0.1 m². The flux through the loop is:
(0.8 T ka uniform field 0.1 m² area wale loop ke normal se 60° ka angle banata hai. Loop se flux kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Then, we will have to use component of B (B cosθ) along the vector area A

blocks.prompt:
40 A flux of 0.06 Wb passes normally through an area of 0.3 m². The magnetic flux density is:
(0.06 Wb flux 0.3 m² area se amoodan guzarta hai. Magnetic flux density kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: the magnetic induction B is the flux per unit area of a surface perpendicular to B

blocks.prompt:
41 A loop is turned in a uniform magnetic field so that the angle between B and its vector area changes from 0° to 60°. The flux through it becomes:
(Uniform magnetic field mein loop ghumaya jata hai aur B aur vector area ka angle 0° se 60° ho jata hai. Flux kitna reh jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: ϕ = BA cos θ; cos 60° = 0.5, is liye flux BA ka aadha reh jata hai (10.2).

book_ref.quote: As B and A both are vectors, so we can write

blocks.prompt:
42 Magnetic flux linkage of a coil is:
(Coil ki magnetic flux linkage kya hai?)

options.text: aik loop ka flux taqseem turns
aik loop ka flux zarb turns ki tadaad

blocks.explanation: Flux linkage Φ = Nϕ_B, aik loop ka flux zarb turns ki tadaad (Eq. 10.7).

book_ref.quote: refers to the product of the magnetic flux through a coil and the number of turns in the coil

blocks.prompt:
43 A coil of 200 turns has a flux of 3 × 10⁻⁴ Wb through each turn. The flux linkage is:
(200 turns wali coil ke har turn se 3 × 10⁻⁴ Wb flux guzarta hai. Flux linkage kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: where ϕ_B is the magnetic flux through a single loop of area A

blocks.prompt:
44 A coil of 50 turns and area 0.01 m² is placed perpendicular to a 0.5 T field. The flux linkage is:
(50 turns aur 0.01 m² area wali coil 0.5 T field par amoodi rakhi hai. Flux linkage kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: It essentially measures how much magnetic flux is linked with the coil

blocks.prompt:
45 Magnetic flux linkage plays a crucial role in the design of:
(Magnetic flux linkage kin cheezon ke design mein aham kirdar ada karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Flux linkage transformers, electric motors, generators aur inductors ke liye aham hai (10.3).

book_ref.quote: plays a crucial role in the design and operation of transformers

blocks.prompt:
46 The magnetic strip of an ATM card stores information in:
(ATM card ki magnetic strip maloomat kis mein mehfooz karti hai?)

options.text: resin binder mein jure lakhon chhote magnetic domains

blocks.explanation: Strip mein lakhon chhote magnetic domains resin binder se jure hote hain; machine unhein parhti hai (10.3 box).

book_ref.quote: A magnetic strip on the card contains millions of tiny magnetic domains

blocks.prompt:
47 If the number of turns of a coil is doubled while the flux through each turn stays the same, the flux linkage:
(Agar coil ke turns double kar diye jayein aur har turn ka flux wahi rahe to flux linkage:)
blocks.explanation: Φ = Nϕ_B; N double karne se flux linkage double ho jati hai (Eq. 10.7).

book_ref.quote: This concept is particularly important in Faraday

blocks.text: 10.4 Motion of a charged particle in a magnetic field

blocks.prompt:
48 A charged particle moving across a magnetic field:
(Magnetic field ke aar paar chalne wala charged particle:)

options.text: us par koi force nahi lagti
us ka charge khatam ho jata hai

blocks.explanation: Tajrubaat batate hain ke magnetic field ke aar paar chalne wale charged particle par force lagti hai (10.4).

book_ref.quote: Experiments show that a charged particle does experience a force when it moves across a magnetic field.

blocks.prompt:
49 N particles, each of charge q, pass through a conductor in time t. The current in the conductor is:
(N particles, har aik ka charge q, t waqt mein conductor se guzarte hain. Conductor mein current kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: I = Q/t = Nq/t, jahan Q = Nq t waqt mein guzarne wala kul charge hai (10.4).

book_ref.quote: N charged particles, each with charge q, are passing in time t

blocks.prompt:
50 Charges moving with speed v along a conductor of length L give a current I equal to:
(L lambai ke conductor mein v speed se chalne wale N charges (har aik q) se current I kitna banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: t = L/v, is liye I = Nq/t = Nqv/L (Eq. 10.8).

book_ref.quote: Since the particles take time t to move across the conductor of length L, therefore,

blocks.prompt:
51 The unit vector L̂ used in the derivation of F = qv × B points in the direction of:
(F = qv × B ki derivation mein unit vector L̂ kis simt mein hai?)

options.text: current, yani positive charges ki harkat

blocks.explanation: L̂ current ki simt mein hai, jo positive charges ki harkat ki simt hai (10.4).

book_ref.quote: is directed along the direction of the current, which is the direction of motion of positive charges

blocks.prompt:
52 The magnetic force on a single charge q moving with velocity v in a magnetic field B is:
(Magnetic field B mein velocity v se chalne wale aik charge q par magnetic force kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: N particles ke liye F = Nq v × B se aik particle par F = q v × B (Eq. 10.13).

book_ref.quote: Therefore the force on a single particle will be

blocks.prompt:
53 The magnetic force on a moving charge is maximum when the angle between v and B is:
(Chalte charge par magnetic force sab se zyada kab hoti hai jab v aur B ka angle ho:)
blocks.explanation: F = qvB sin θ, θ = 90° par sab se zyada (10.4).

book_ref.quote: the force is maximum when B is perpendicular to v

blocks.prompt:
54 A charge moving at 30° to a uniform magnetic field experiences a force F. With the same speed at 90° to the field, the force is:
(Uniform magnetic field se 30° par chalte charge par force F hai. Usi speed se field se 90° par chale to force kitni hogi?)
blocks.explanation: F = qvB sin θ; sin 90°/sin 30° = 1/0.5 = 2, is liye force 2F. Sirf field ki seedh mein (θ = 0) force sifar hoti hai (10.4).

book_ref.quote: force is zero when B is in the direction of v

blocks.prompt:
55 A proton (q = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) moves at 2 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ perpendicular to a field of 0.5 T. The magnetic force on it is:
(Proton (q = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) 0.5 T field par amoodi 2 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ se chal raha hai. Us par magnetic force kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: If θ is the angle between B and v, then magnitude of force F is given by

(Electron (charge 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) 0.25 T field se 30° par 4 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ se chal raha hai. Us par force ki magnitude kitni hai?)

blocks.explanation: Fig. 10.10 mein positive charge oopar aur negative charge neeche dhakela jata hai (10.4).

book_ref.quote: It experiences a force in the upward direction

blocks.prompt:
58 For an electron moving in a circle inside a uniform magnetic field, the centripetal force is provided by:
(Uniform magnetic field mein daire mein chalte electron ko centripetal force kaun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Force evB, v par amoodi hai, is liye yahi centripetal force deti hai: evB = mv²/r (Example 10.3).

book_ref.quote: Since F acts perpendicular to v, so this force provides centripetal force

blocks.prompt:

book_ref.quote: The path of electron will be a circle of radius

blocks.prompt:

book_ref.quote: Putting the values in above equation, we have

(Uniform magnetic field par amoodi chalte charged particle ki speed double kar di jaye to us ke daire ka radius:)
blocks.explanation: evB = mv²/r se r = mv/eB, is liye r, v ke tanasub mein hai (Example 10.3).

book_ref.quote: keep it in a circle of radius r. Then

62 Magnetic field lines, like electric field lines:
(Magnetic field lines, electric field lines ki tarah:)

options.text: kabhi aik doosre ko nahi kaatteen
aik doosre ko 90° par kaatteen hain
sirf charges ke gird band loops banati hain

blocks.explanation: Magnetic field lines kabhi aik doosre ko nahi kaattein balkay aik doosre se door hatti hain (10.4 box).

book_ref.quote: Like electric field lines, magnetic field lines also never cross each other

blocks.prompt:
63 A velocity selector is a device used to:
(Velocity selector kis kaam ka aala hai?)

options.text: charged particle ki velocity maloom karna

blocks.explanation: Velocity selector charged particle ki velocity maloom (select) karta hai (10.5).

book_ref.quote: A velocity selector is a device used to determine the velocity of a charged particle.

blocks.prompt:
64 In a velocity selector, the electric field E and the magnetic field B are:
(Velocity selector mein electric field E aur magnetic field B aapas mein kaise hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Capacitor ka field E magnetic field B par amoodi rakha jata hai (Fig. 10.12).

book_ref.quote: Inside the tube is a parallel plate capacitor that creates a uniform electric field E

blocks.prompt:
